_about: Put this file in your GitHub repo and set REMOTE_RULES_URL in src/services/remoteRules.ts to its raw URL. Bump 'version' every time you edit. textReplacements run BEFORE the classifier (teach new words). rules run AFTER it; the FIRST matching rule overrides the result. A rule needs senderRegex and/or textRegex (case-insensitive regex); notTextRegex excludes. 'set' can hold: isTransaction, type, category, subCategory, merchant, needsReview. Test everything in tools/sms-tester.html first.

rules.textRegex: payment of .* (has been )?(received|reeived|recieved) on your .* credit card
